name: use-user-media
title: useUserMedia
description: Constraints for the `useUserMedia` hook. Defines the video and audio settings for the media stream.

types.name: UseUserMediaConstraints
types.description:
Constraints for the `useUserMedia` hook.
Defines the video and audio settings for the media stream.

properties.name: video
properties.description: Boolean or specific constraints for the video track.

properties.name: audio
properties.description: Boolean or specific constraints for the audio track.

parameters.name: initialConstraints
parameters.description: - The initial constraints for audio and video.

properties.name: video
properties.description: Boolean or specific constraints for the video track.

properties.name: audio
properties.description: Boolean or specific constraints for the audio track.

returnType.name: UseUserMediaReturn
returnType.description: An object containing the stream, error state, and control functions.

properties.name: stream
properties.description: The current MediaStream object, or null if no stream is active.

properties.name: error
properties.description: An error message string if the media capture failed, or null otherwise.

properties.name: isLoading
properties.description: A boolean indicating if the media stream is currently loading (requesting permission).

properties.name: isSupported
properties.description: A boolean indicating if the `getUserMedia` API is supported in the current environment.

properties.name: startCapture
properties.description: Function to start capturing media. Accepts optional constraints to override defaults.

properties.name: stopCapture
properties.description: Function to stop the current media capture and release tracks.
